usage: agentware worklog scan [-h] [--format {text,json}] --path PATH
                              [--also-assessment]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --path PATH           path to a worklog.md
  --also-assessment     ADVISORY sidecar: also flag Extracted-Knowledge
                        'Suggested ID' entries in the sibling assessment.md
                        that never reached the live index (the POST-phase
                        knowledge leak). Report-only — it NEVER changes the
                        exit code, so every gate that calls `worklog scan`
                        WITHOUT the flag is byte-for-byte unaffected.
